Jigsaw scene: Which place does the picture show?
Jigsaw scene. The board has 8x8 sites (128x128 cells). The window shows one site; each move goes to the next site (up, down, left or right). The pieces of one landscape picture lie on the board in their places: the ground piece at the bottom middle, the plant piece at the middle left, the building piece in the middle and the sky piece at the top right. Every other site is a blank piece. The picture may sit one site further left or right. A building piece with no building looks like a blank piece. The ground piece shows water or plain land, the plant piece shows trees or only grass, and the sky piece shows falling snow or the sun. Question: Which place does the picture show? The answer is one of ten places: harbour = water, no trees, buildings, no snow; island = water, trees, no buildings, no snow; lakeside cabin = water, trees, buildings, no snow; frozen lake = water, no trees, no buildings, snow; fishing village = water, no trees, buildings, snow; snowy woods = no water, trees, no buildings, snow; ski resort = no water, trees, buildings, snow; city = no water, no trees, buildings, no snow; jungle = no water, trees, no buildings, no snow; snowfield = no water, no trees, no buildings, snow. Answer with its name. You may answer at any time; you do not need to see every site. Score: 20 if the answer is right, minus 10, minus 0.1 per move (movement budget 35).
The answers: 1 = harbour, 2 = island, 3 = lakeside cabin, 4 = frozen lake, 5 = fishing village, 6 = snowy woods, 7 = ski resort, 8 = city, 9 = jungle, 10 = snowfield.
